summary.intent: Debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging by identifying why the load test's register-cid and ipns-publish calls were failing against the staging API.
summary.outcome: Discovered that register-cid was returning 403 (not 400) because setByoStatus had no controller endpoint, and ipns-publish was sending wrong fields. Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint, fixed the load test's ipns-publish to use createAndPublishIpnsRecord, and fixed 9 pre-existing API test files with broken mock typing patterns.

repo: setByoStatus() existed as a VaultService method but had no controller endpoint and was never called — BYO mode could not be toggled via the API at all
The tee-worker package was moved from /tee-worker to /apps/tee-worker in the Phase 35 merge
All roadmap phases are completed as of this session — new work items don't map to phases
The API client openapi.json lives at packages/api-client/openapi.json, not apps/api/openapi.json

The load test byo-file-workload was decomposing the BYO pipeline manually but using wrong DTO fields for ipns-publish — it sent { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid }
Pre-existing pattern across many API spec files: jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> loses mock methods after module.get() — should use mock objects directly or use importActual spread pattern
streaming-crypto.service.ts in the web app uses a File-object-based selectEncryptionMode wrapper; the centralized version in sdk-core takes (mimeType, size) primitives

code.finding: New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added with ByoStatusDto request and ByoStatusResponseDto response
New file: request DTO (enabled: boolean) and response DTO (isByoUser: boolean) for byo-status endpoint
createByoClientPool now calls PATCH /vault/byo-status for each account and filters out accounts where enabling BYO fails
ipns-publish step replaced from wrong raw HTTP call to sdk-core createAndPublishIpnsRecord; createSdkContext hoisted outside iteration loop
New centralized module with STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD, selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), and normalizeEncryptionMode(mode)
uploadFile now accepts optional encryptionMode param; uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when 'CTR', falls back to GCM
uploadFile now calls selectEncryptionMode imported from sdk-core instead of duplicating the MIME type set locally
selectEncryptionMode now delegates to sdk-core's selectEncryptionMode(file.type, file.size) instead of maintaining a duplicate MIME set
Removed test.skip from CTR encrypted badge test after SDK fix; all 6 tests pass including the previously-skipped one

workflow: When the mock pattern jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> is used, always reference the original mock variable directly rather than re-getting from the NestJS test module — the re-get loses the mock methods
Regenerating the API client requires the API server to be running OR building first then running orval directly — the api:generate script includes a lint step that can fail on unrelated files
When centralizing shared utilities between packages, use (mimeType: string, size: number) primitives rather than browser APIs like File so the utility works in SDK/Node contexts too
PR coverage bots flag patch coverage; adding endpoint tests for happy path + error cases is sufficient to satisfy the threshold
After a merge that brings both pending/ and done/ copies of a todo into main, the stale pending copy should be cleaned up immediately

friction: The todo move created duplicate pending/done copies after the PR merged — both were committed to main because the branch was based on fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 which itself had the pending copy
GraphQL API timed out during review thread resolution; had to fall back to REST for fetching and workaround for resolving
Manual openapi.json generation wrote to apps/api/openapi.json (cwd) instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json, requiring a cleanup commit
Pre-existing test errors across 9 API spec files consumed significant session time — systemic jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern issue that should be fixed proactively going forward
The api:generate script failed due to Rust doc file lint errors unrelated to the API changes, blocking the normal code generation workflow
SDK typecheck failed after encryption-mode centralization because sdk-core build output was stale — required manual rebuild before sdk typecheck would pass
